title: Mixed Event — What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic! — Episode8 Talk To Me, One Day

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!
meta.Episode: Episode8 — Talk To Me, One Day
meta.Event Outline: Noticing Mizuki's lackluster attitude following the mystery tour, Ena grows worried. Her apparent concern for her friend doesn't go unnoticed by Airi and Shizuku, who extend an invitation to a picnic to both of them in hopes of lifting their spirits.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <You had quite an adventure today, Mizuki...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, but I'm glad we all came back in one piece. I owe you, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <On the other hand, I never knew you could make that kind of face, Mizuki.>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <That look of desperation you had on your face when you were looking for help.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's how I looked?! Wipe that from your mind, will you? That was probably the opposite of the cute and fashionable me that you usually see...>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: <Also, was that girl the one you mentioned to me before? Your "friend"?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <*Sigh*... Anyways, I'm super tired. I'm gonna go to bed now. Bye, Rui.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I have to find a way to save Ena and Airi...!)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Did I really look that desperate?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Thanks for today. Airi, Shizuku and I were thinking about having a group call. Wanna join?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (A group call...? That might be fun... I did like talking to Airi and Shizuku...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I just got a reply. Mizuki's tired and going to bed it looks like...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Right. I'd be exhausted too if I had to run around like that...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
I need to thank you too, Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <No, Mizuki did all the work. I just sort of followed along...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <The other people from the tour were so understanding too...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I know, right? I'm glad everyone was so nice about what happened.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <I was surprised to hear that it was actually Mizuki's friends who came to help us in the end.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, we're in different classes but go to the same school. I should thank them again if I get a chance to see them.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <But I also feel bad about losing track of why we went there in the first place...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Yes, helping Mizuki turned into something much more drastic...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<It's okay, really.
I'm still glad we went.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're safe now and that's what matters most.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Today was the first time in a while that I'd seen Mizuki genuinely having a good time...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I learned today that I really do want to know more about what's bothering Mizuki.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I don't know if it's okay for me to keep pushing like this...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But nothing's gonna change unless I do something about it.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Mizuki helped me today, so it's my turn to return the favor.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I doubt I'll really learn anything soon, but I want to know more about Mizuki...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I'll keep trying until things do start to actually change...!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Hehe. Looks like Ena's back to her usual self.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Look who's talking. You're the one that told me that not giving up is my best quality, Airi.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Because it is. I really like that part of you, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <And feel free to ask us again if there's something you'd like help with. We'll gladly lend you a hand.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Also, how would you guys feel about going out together again?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <That sounds wonderful! I'm sure it'll be even more fun if both Ena and Mizuki come along!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Mizuki does seem like a good kid. We might just go without you, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But in that case, how does shopping sound? I kind of ruined Mizuki's favorite outfit, so we should probably find something new to replace it.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Right. Mizuki's very cute and stylish too, so I'm sure we'll be able to find something good. We'll let you know when our practice schedule is all set.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<*Yawn*... I'm getting pretty sleepy...
I think I'll head off to bed...>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
<Oh, it is getting late.
I'll do the same then.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Bye, you two!
And thanks again for today!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're safe now and that's what matters most.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I want Mizuki to smile like that more...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I get that I might start being a nuisance...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Because Mizuki's someone I really care about.)
